gloss: Gothic typeface; sans-serif font (in Japanese typography)

definitions.gloss: Gothic typeface; sans-serif font (in Japanese typography)
definitions.explanation: In Japanese typography, ゴシック{体|たい} refers to sans-serif fonts, which is different from the Western meaning of Gothic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{見出|みだ}し→見出し：04440_midashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ゴシック{体|たい}にして⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please make the headings in Gothic (sans-serif) font.

examples.japanese: ゴシック{体|たい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{画面上|がめんじょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧やすい。
examples.english: Gothic (sans-serif) fonts are easy to read on screen.

examples.japanese: ⟦プレゼン→プレゼン：05505_purezen⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明朝体|みんちょうたい}→明朝体：22715_minchoutai⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧ゴシック{体|たい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{向|む}いている→向く：02304_muku⟧。
examples.english: Gothic (sans-serif) fonts are more suitable than Mincho (serif) fonts for presentation materials.

notes:
In Japanese typography, ゴシック{体|たい} refers to sans-serif typefaces — fonts with uniform stroke width and no decorative serifs. This is confusingly different from the Western use of "Gothic" which often refers to blackletter or ornamental serif typefaces.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {太|ふと}ゴシック{体|たい}: bold Gothic (heavy sans-serif)
- ⟦{丸|まる}→丸：02167_maru⟧ゴシック{体|たい}: rounded Gothic
- ゴシック{体|たい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{表示|ひょうじ}する→表示する：26973_hyoujisuru⟧: to display in Gothic font

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{明朝体|みんちょうたい}→明朝体：22715_minchoutai⟧: Mincho typeface (serif font) — the main counterpart
- サンセリフ: sans-serif (technical loanword, less commonly used)
- {教科書体|きょうかしょたい}: textbook typeface

USAGE:
Major Japanese ゴシック{体|たい} fonts include ヒラギノ{角|かく}ゴ, {游|ゆう}ゴシック, and メイリオ. Used widely in digital interfaces, signage, and headings where legibility at various sizes is important.
